A6-P2_RATIO-OF-RATIO.verdict_note: measured pooled Spearman rho(anchor R = g/(A_abs+0.01), control raw g) = 0.9929 over 1383 symbol-dates, above the 0.95 flag line by 0.0429. The aggression denominator is a positive scalar with insufficient cross-sectional dispersion to reorder the ranking: the control book is a near-clone of the anchor book. Under the preregistered non-reproduction rule EVERY outcome then kills the family: anchor expectancy > 0 => near-clone control also > 0 and >= 0.5 x anchor => FALSIFIED_BY_CONTROL; anchor expectancy <= 0 => MECHANISM_DEAD. The falsification apparatus cannot return 'survive'; void by measured construction. Independent second thinness: stress-tier break-even edge 5.95 bps/decision already exceeds the A9F-declared 5.0 ceiling (margin -0.95)
